source.text: לְדָוִ֨ד׀שָׁפְטֵ֤נִי יְהוָ֗ה כִּֽי־אֲ֭נִי בְּתֻמִּ֣י הָלַ֑כְתִּי וּבַיהוָ֥ה בָּ֝טַ֗חְתִּי לֹ֣א אֶמְעָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: Of David. Judge me, YHWH, for I in my integrity have walked, and in YHWH I have trusted; I will not slip.

en.L: Of David. Judge me, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, for I have walked in my integrity, and in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} I have trusted; I will not slip.
en.B: Of David. {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, decide my case, for I have walked with integrity; my trust has been in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and I will not stumble.
en.R: By David. {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, show that I am in the right. I have lived an honest life. I have trusted {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and I will not fall.

fr.L: De David. Juge-moi, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car moi, j’ai marché dans mon intégrité, et en {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} j’ai eu confiance ; je ne chancellerai pas.
fr.B: De David. {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, tranche ma cause, car j’ai marché avec intégrité ; c’est en {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} que j’ai mis ma confiance, et je ne trébucherai pas.
fr.R: Par David. {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, montre que je suis dans mon droit. J’ai mené une vie honnête. J’ai fait confiance {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, et je ne tomberai pas.

sw.L: Ya Daudi. Unihukumu, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana mimi nimeenenda katika uadilifu wangu, na katika {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} nimetumaini; sitateleza.
sw.B: Ya Daudi. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, uamue shauri langu, kwa maana nimeishi kwa uadilifu; tumaini langu limekuwa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nami sitajikwaa.
sw.R: Ya Daudi. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, onyesha kwamba mimi niko sahihi. Nimeishi kwa moyo mnyoofu. Nimemtumaini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nami sitaanguka.

es.L: De David. Júzgame, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, porque yo he andado en mi integridad, y en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} he confiado; no resbalaré.
es.B: De David. {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, defiende mi causa, porque he andado con integridad; mi confianza ha estado en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y no tropezaré.
es.R: Escrito por David. {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, demuestra que tengo la razón. He vivido una vida honrada. He confiado en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y no caeré.

vi.L: Của Đa-vít. Xin xét xử tôi, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì tôi đã bước đi trong sự trọn vẹn của tôi, và nơi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tôi đã tin cậy; tôi sẽ không trượt ngã.
vi.B: Của Đa-vít. Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin phân xử cho tôi, vì tôi đã sống ngay thật trọn vẹn; tôi vẫn tin cậy nơi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và tôi sẽ không vấp ngã.
vi.R: Của Đa-vít. Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin cho mọi người thấy tôi là người ngay. Tôi đã sống một đời ngay thật. Tôi đã tin cậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và tôi sẽ không bị ngã.

ko.L: 다윗의 [시]. 저를 판단해 주십시오, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여. 참으로 저는 제 온전함 가운데 걸어왔고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 신뢰하였습니다. 저는 미끄러지지 않을 것입니다.
ko.B: 다윗의 시. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제 사정을 판결해 주십시오. 저는 온전하게 살아왔습니다. 제가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 신뢰해 왔으니 흔들리지 않을 것입니다.
ko.R: 다윗이 지은 노래. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제가 옳다는 것을 밝혀 주십시오. 저는 정직하게 살아왔습니다. 저는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 믿어 왔으니 넘어지지 않을 것입니다.

pt.L: De Davi. Julga-me, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, pois eu na minha integridade tenho andado, e {{divine_name:no SENHOR|em Javé}} tenho confiado; não escorregarei.
pt.B: De Davi. {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, decide a minha causa, pois tenho vivido com integridade; a minha confiança está {{divine_name:no SENHOR|em Javé}}, e não vou tropeçar.
pt.R: De Davi. {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, mostra que eu estou com a razão. Tenho levado uma vida honesta. Tenho confiado {{divine_name:no SENHOR|em Javé}}, e não vou cair.

am.L: የዳዊት። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ፍረድልኝ፤ እኔ በፍጹምነቴ ሄጃለሁና፤ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}}ም ታምኛለሁ፤ አልንሸራተትም።
am.B: የዳዊት። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ፍርዴን ስጠኝ፤ በፍጹምነት ኖሬአለሁና፤ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ታምኛለሁ፤ ከቶም አልሰናከልም።
am.R: ዳዊት የዘመረው። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ትክክል መሆኔን አሳይ። በታማኝነት ኖሬአለሁ። {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ታምኛለሁ፤ አልወድቅምም።

hi.L: दाऊद का। \q हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मेरा न्याय कर, क्योंकि मैं अपनी खराई में चलता आया हूँ, और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} पर मैंने भरोसा रखा है; \q मैं नहीं फिसलूँगा।
hi.B: दाऊद का। \q हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मेरे मुक़दमे का फ़ैसला कर, क्योंकि मैंने खराई से जीवन बिताया है; \q मेरा भरोसा {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} पर रहा है, और मैं ठोकर नहीं खाऊँगा।
hi.R: दाऊद का लिखा हुआ। \q हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, दिखा दे कि मैं सही हूँ। मैंने ईमानदारी का जीवन जिया है। \q मैंने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} पर भरोसा रखा है, और मैं नहीं गिरूँगा।

ru.L: Давида. \q Суди меня, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, ведь я ходил в моей непорочности, и на {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} я уповал; \q не поскользнусь.
ru.B: Давида. \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, рассуди моё дело, ведь я жил непорочно; \q я полагался на {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и не споткнусь.
ru.R: Написал Давид. \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, покажи, что я прав. Я жил честно. \q Я доверял {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, и я не упаду.

ja.L: ダビデによる。 \q わたしを裁いてください、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ。まことに、わたしは潔白のうちに歩み、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に信頼してきた。 \q わたしはよろめかない。
ja.B: ダビデによる。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしの訴えを裁いてください。わたしは潔白に歩んできた。 \q わたしは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に信頼してきたので、つまずくことはない。
ja.R: ダビデによる。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしが正しいことを示してください。わたしは正直に生きてきた。 \q わたしは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に信頼してきたから、倒れることはない。

uk.L: Давидів. \q Суди мене, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, бо я ходив у своїй непорочності, і на {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} я покладався; \q я не похитнуся.
uk.B: Давидів. \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, розсуди мою справу, бо я жив непорочно; \q я покладався на {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, і я не спіткнуся.
uk.R: Давидова пісня. \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, покажи, що я правий. Я жив чесним життям. \q Я довіряв {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, і я не впаду.

decisions.choice: The title shares verse 1
decisions.reason: This psalm's title is short and the Hebrew counts it together with the first line as verse 1, so here the verse numbers are the same as in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: Judge me: decide my case, vindicate me
decisions.reason: The verb (shafat) asks God as judge to rule in the psalmist's favor and so clear him (7:9; 35:24).

decisions.choice: integrity: a whole-hearted, sincere life
decisions.reason: The word (tom) is wholeness, a life with no double dealing; it is not a claim to be sinless. The psalmist asks to be cleared of the charges of the wicked.

decisions.choice: I will not slip: without slipping
decisions.reason: The words may state the result of trust ("I will not slip") or describe the trust ("without slipping").

decisions.choice: show that I am in the right
decisions.reason: Readable says what the request to be judged means (m2).

decisions.choice: "SEIGNEUR" in capitals for the name YHWH, with "Yahvé" as the divine_name alternative; "Ô" is not added when the name is called on ("Juge-moi, SEIGNEUR")
decisions.reason: As the French terms for the Pentateuch set, for the whole block of Psalms 26-44: capitals mark the name, like the English "LORD". "L’Éternel" is the traditional French alternative a reviewer may prefer.

decisions.choice: the psalmist speaks to God with "tu" ("Juge-moi", "ton amour"), and the pronouns for God take the deity_pronoun setting ("ton" or "Ton")
decisions.reason: Modern French prayer and the French style guide address God with "tu", as the Hebrew does; "vous" would be an older, more distant register. A pronoun that opens a sentence is written with its capital and no setting.

decisions.choice: "BWANA" in capitals by default, "Yahwe" as the setting alternative, through these psalms
decisions.reason: As in the rest of the Old Testament: the capitals show that the Hebrew has the divine name here, and the reader may switch to the name itself. When the psalmist calls on God, Swahili uses the name as a plain address, without "Ee".

decisions.choice: "uadilifu" for integrity (L, B); "moyo mnyoofu" (an upright heart) at Readable
decisions.reason: "Ukamilifu" sounds like being without any fault, which the psalmist does not claim; "uadilifu" is an honest, sincere life. Readable uses the everyday picture of a straight heart, as the English Readable says "an honest life".

decisions.choice: Escrito por David
decisions.reason: As the English Readable says "By David", the Readable makes plain that the title names David as the author; Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew's short "De David". The same is done in every title of this block of psalms.

decisions.choice: "Lạy CHÚA" when the singer calls on God, and "Ngài" for "you" through these psalms
decisions.reason: As in the published Psalms 23 and 139: Vietnamese calls on God with "Lạy", which the grammar of prayer requires, so Literal does not bracket it; the singer says "tôi" for himself and speaks to God as "Ngài" with the deity_pronoun setting.

decisions.choice: "Của Đa-vít" for the short title at every level
decisions.reason: The Hebrew title here is only "of David", with no word for psalm, so no level adds "thi thiên"; "của" keeps the Hebrew's open sense (by, for or about David).

decisions.choice: The psalm is spoken to God in 합쇼체; the singer is "저/제"; God is called by name with "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}여" and addressed by title, "주님" (주님께서, 주님의); no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: Style guide section 7a (speech levels in prayer), as in the published Psalms 23 and 139. Korean addresses a superior by title, not by a pronoun. Hangul has no capitals, so the English deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change; respect is carried by 주님, 께서 and -시-. This holds for Psalms 26-44 wherever the singer speaks to God; where a psalm speaks about God, it uses the plain written style with the honorific and "나".

decisions.choice: The short title "Of David" is "다윗의 [시]" (L), "다윗의 시" (B), "다윗이 지은 노래" (R)
decisions.reason: A Korean genitive cannot stand without a noun, so Literal supplies "poem" in brackets and Balanced gives it plainly; Readable says "a song David made", as the published titles do ("다윗이 지은 노래"). The same form serves every psalm titled "Of David" in this block.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of Psalm 26.
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; pronouns and verb forms for God are written plainly.

decisions.choice: "ፍረድልኝ" (judge for me) for "judge me"; integrity "ፍጹምነት"
decisions.reason: The plea is to decide the case in the psalmist's favour (meaning decision m2), which the benefactive "-ልኝ" says; integrity is the whole-hearted life of m3, and verse 11 uses the same word.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the setting the English offers has nothing to change in Hindi. The psalm speaks to God with the devotional तू and about him with the honorific plural (वे).

decisions.choice: खराई (L, B); ईमानदारी (R)
decisions.reason: Integrity is a whole-hearted, sincere life (m3): खराई, the word Hindi uses for it in Job and the Psalms; Readable says ईमानदारी, the everyday word.

decisions.choice: "непорочность", "непорочно"
decisions.reason: The word (tom) is a whole-hearted, sincere life (m3); "непорочность" is the usual Russian word for it and is kept for this word through the block, with "честно" at Readable.

decisions.choice: shofteni "わたしを裁いてください" (L), "わたしの訴えを裁いてください" (B), "わたしが正しいことを示してください" (R)
decisions.reason: The plea is to decide his case and vindicate him (m2), not to condemn; Balanced names the case, Readable says the outcome, as the English Readable.

decisions.choice: tummi "潔白" (L, B), "正直" (R), as tom in 25:21
decisions.reason: Integrity is a whole-hearted, sincere life (m3); 潔白 keeps tom apart from chesed (誠実) at Literal and Balanced.

source.text: בְּחָנֵ֣נִי יְהוָ֣ה וְנַסֵּ֑נִי צָרְפָ֖ה כִלְיוֹתַ֣י וְלִבִּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Examine me, YHWH, and test me; refine my kidneys and my heart.

en.L: Examine me, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, and put me to the test; refine my kidneys and my heart.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, examine me and put me through trials; refine my innermost feelings and my mind.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, test me and see what I am really like. Look deep inside me at what I want and what I think.

fr.L: Examine-moi, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et mets-moi à l’épreuve ; passe au creuset mes reins et mon cœur.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, examine-moi et éprouve-moi ; passe au creuset mes sentiments les plus intimes et ma pensée.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, mets-moi à l’épreuve et vois ce que je suis vraiment. Regarde au fond de moi ce que je désire et ce que je pense.

sw.L: Unichunguze, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na unijaribu; uzisafishe figo zangu na moyo wangu.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unichunguze na unipitishe katika majaribu; uzisafishe hisia zangu za ndani na mawazo yangu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unijaribu uone jinsi nilivyo kweli. Tazama ndani kabisa mwangu, uone ninachokitaka na ninachokifikiri.

es.L: Examíname, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y ponme a prueba; refina mis riñones y mi corazón.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, examíname y sométeme a prueba; purifica mis sentimientos más hondos y mi mente.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ponme a prueba y mira cómo soy de verdad. Mira muy dentro de mí lo que deseo y lo que pienso.

vi.L: Xin dò xét tôi, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và thử thách tôi; xin luyện lọc tim gan và lòng tôi.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin dò xét tôi và đem tôi qua thử thách; xin luyện lọc những cảm xúc sâu kín nhất và tâm trí tôi.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin thử tôi và xem tôi thật sự là người thế nào. Xin nhìn sâu vào trong tôi, thấy điều tôi muốn và điều tôi nghĩ.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저를 살피시고 시험해 보십시오. 제 콩팥과 제 마음을 제련하십시오.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저를 살피시고 시련으로 시험해 보십시오. 제 가장 깊은 속마음과 생각을 단련해 주십시오.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저를 시험하셔서 제가 정말 어떤 사람인지 보아 주십시오. 제 속 깊은 곳을 들여다보시고, 제가 무엇을 바라고 무엇을 생각하는지 살펴 주십시오.

pt.L: Examina-me, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, e põe-me à prova; refina os meus rins e o meu coração.
pt.B: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, examina-me e submete-me a provas; purifica os meus sentimentos mais profundos e a minha mente.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, põe-me à prova e vê como eu realmente sou. Olha bem dentro de mim, para o que eu desejo e o que eu penso.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ መርምረኝ፤ ፈትነኝም፤ ኩላሊቴንና ልቤን አንጥር።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ መርምረኝ፤ በፈተናም አሳልፈኝ፤ የውስጤን ስሜትና አእምሮዬን አንጥር።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ፈትነኝ፤ ምን ዓይነት ሰው እንደ ሆንኩም እይ። የምፈልገውንና የማስበውን በውስጤ ጠልቀህ ተመልከት።

hi.L: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मुझे जाँच और मुझे परख; \q मेरे गुर्दों और मेरे हृदय को ताया।
hi.B: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मुझे जाँच और परीक्षाओं से होकर निकाल; \q मेरी भीतरी भावनाओं और मेरे मन को आग में तपाकर शुद्ध कर।
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मुझे परखकर देख कि मैं सचमुच कैसा हूँ। \q मेरे भीतर गहराई तक झाँककर देख कि मैं क्या चाहता हूँ और क्या सोचता हूँ।

ru.L: Исследуй меня, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, и испытай меня; \q переплавь почки мои и сердце моё.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, исследуй меня и проведи через испытания; \q очисти, как в огне, мои сокровенные чувства и мои мысли.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, испытай меня и посмотри, какой я на самом деле. \q Загляни глубоко в меня и посмотри, чего я хочу и о чём думаю.

ja.L: わたしを調べてください、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしを試してください。 \q わたしの腎臓とわたしの心を精錬してください。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしを調べ、試練にかけてください。 \q 火で金属を試すように、わたしの心の奥底と思いを試してください。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしを試して、わたしが本当はどういう者かを見てください。 \q わたしの心の奥深くを見て、わたしが何を望み、何を考えているかを、調べてください。

uk.L: Досліди мене, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, і випробуй мене; \q переплав мої нирки й моє серце.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, досліди мене й пропусти крізь випробування; \q переплав мої найглибші почуття й мої думки.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, випробуй мене й подивися, який я насправді. \q Зазирни глибоко в мене, у те, чого я хочу і що думаю.

decisions.choice: my kidneys and my heart: my inmost self
decisions.reason: The kidneys stand for the deepest feelings and desires, the heart for thought and will; together they are the whole inner person (7:10; Jeremiah 17:10).

decisions.choice: refine: test as metal is tested in the fire
decisions.reason: The verb (tsaraf) is used of refining silver (12:7); testing removes what is false and shows what is true.

decisions.choice: my innermost feelings and my mind (B); what I want and what I think (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the idiom means (m1).

decisions.choice: "tim gan" for "kidneys"
decisions.reason: Hebrew names the kidneys as the seat of hidden feelings (see the meaning decision). Vietnamese "tim gan" (heart and liver) is the body word it uses for the same hidden inner self, so Literal keeps a body image without sounding strange; Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: refina os meus rins
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture: "refinar" is the word for purifying metal in the fire (m2), and "os rins" stand for the inmost feelings (m1), as the English Literal keeps "kidneys"; Balanced and Readable say what they mean.

decisions.choice: "ኩላሊቴን" (my kidneys) kept at Literal
decisions.reason: The Hebrew pictures the inmost self as the kidneys and the heart (meaning decision m1); Balanced and Readable say what is meant, as the English.

decisions.choice: ताया; गुर्दों
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of metal tested in the fire (ताना, m2) and the Hebrew "kidneys" (गुर्दे), the seat of feeling; Balanced and Readable say what the idiom means (m1), as the English does.

decisions.choice: "почки"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew organ, as the English does; Balanced and Readable say what it stands for (m1).

decisions.choice: tsorfah kilyotai velibbi "わたしの腎臓とわたしの心を精錬して" (L), "火で金属を試すように、わたしの心の奥底と思いを試して" (B), "心の奥深くを見て、…何を望み、何を考えているか" (R)
decisions.reason: Kidneys and heart are the inmost self, feelings and mind (m1), and refining is testing metal in the fire (m2); kilyot 腎臓 (L), 心の奥底 (B), 心の奥深く (R) as Psalm 16:7.

records.literal_gloss: For your loyal love [is] before my eyes, and I have walked about in your faithfulness.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love [is] before my eyes, and I have walked in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithfulness.
en.B: I have kept {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love in view, and I have lived my life by {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithfulness.
en.R: I keep thinking about {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful love. I live each day trusting that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} keep {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal [est] devant mes yeux, et j’ai marché dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fidélité.
fr.B: J’ai gardé {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle sous mes yeux, et j’ai conduit ma vie selon {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fidélité.
fr.R: Je pense sans cesse à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle. Je vis chaque jour en comptant sur {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} tiens parole.

sw.L: Kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma [uko] mbele ya macho yangu, nami nimeenenda katika uaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.B: Nimeuweka upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma mbele ya macho yangu, nami nimeishi maisha yangu kwa uaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.R: Ninaendelea kuufikiria upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma. Kila siku ninaishi nikitumaini kwamba unatimiza neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}.

es.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor leal [está] delante de mis ojos, y he andado en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fidelidad.
es.B: He tenido siempre presente {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel, y he vivido conforme a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fidelidad.
es.R: Siempre pienso en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel. Vivo cada día confiando en que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} cumples {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palabra.

vi.L: Vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [ở] trước mắt tôi, và tôi đã bước đi trong sự thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Tôi luôn giữ tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trước mắt mình, và tôi đã sống theo sự thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Tôi luôn nghĩ đến tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Mỗi ngày tôi sống trong niềm tin rằng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giữ lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa.

ko.L: 참으로 주님의 한결같은 사랑이 제 눈앞에 [있고], 저는 주님의 신실하심 가운데 걸어왔습니다.
ko.B: 저는 주님의 한결같은 사랑을 늘 눈앞에 두었고, 주님의 신실하심을 따라 살아왔습니다.
ko.R: 저는 주님의 변함없는 사랑을 늘 생각합니다. 주님께서 약속을 지키신다고 믿으며 날마다 살아갑니다.

pt.L: Pois o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor leal [está] diante dos meus olhos, e tenho andado na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} fidelidade.
pt.B: Tenho mantido à vista o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor leal e tenho vivido pela {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} fidelidade.
pt.R: Eu não paro de pensar no {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor fiel. Vivo cada dia confiando que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} cumpres a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} palavra.

am.L: ጽኑ ፍቅርህ በዓይኖቼ ፊት [ነው]ና፤ በታማኝነትህም ተመላልሻለሁ።
am.B: ጽኑ ፍቅርህን ሁልጊዜ በፊቴ አድርጌአለሁ፤ ሕይወቴንም በታማኝነትህ መርቻለሁ።
am.R: ስለ ጽኑ ፍቅርህ ዘወትር አስባለሁ። ቃልህን እንደምትጠብቅ እየታመንኩ በየቀኑ እኖራለሁ።

hi.L: क्योंकि तेरा अटल प्रेम मेरी आँखों के सामने [है], \q और मैं तेरी सच्चाई में चलता-फिरता रहा हूँ।
hi.B: मैंने तेरे अटल प्रेम को अपनी आँखों के सामने रखा है, \q और तेरी विश्वासयोग्यता के अनुसार जीवन बिताया है।
hi.R: मैं तेरे अटल प्रेम के बारे में सोचता रहता हूँ। \q मैं हर दिन इस भरोसे से जीता हूँ कि तू अपना वचन निभाता है।

ru.L: Ведь {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} неизменная любовь — перед глазами моими, \q и я ходил в {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} верности.
ru.B: Я не терял из виду {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} неизменную любовь и жил, \q опираясь на {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} верность.
ru.R: Я всё время думаю о {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} неизменной любви. Я живу каждый день, \q веря, что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} держишь своё слово.

ja.L: まことに、あなたの誠実はわたしの目の前に[あり]、 \q わたしはあなたのまことのうちを歩んできた。
ja.B: わたしは、あなたの変わらぬいつくしみをいつも目の前に置き、 \q あなたのまことに従って生きてきた。
ja.R: わたしは、あなたの変わらぬいつくしみのことを、いつも思っている。 \q あなたが約束を守ってくださると信じて、毎日を生きている。

uk.L: Бо {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} незмінна любов — перед моїми очима, \q і я ходив у {{deity_pronoun:твоїй|Твоїй}} вірності.
uk.B: Я не випускав з поля зору {{deity_pronoun:твоєї|Твоєї}} незмінної любові \q і жив {{deity_pronoun:твоєю|Твоєю}} вірністю.
uk.R: Я постійно думаю про {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} вірну любов. Я живу кожен день, довіряючи, \q що {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} дотримуєш свого слова.

decisions.choice: loyal love: love that keeps faith
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is love that keeps its commitments, the faithful kindness of the covenant (Exodus 34:6-7).

decisions.choice: your faithfulness: your truth, your reliability
decisions.reason: The word ('emet) is what is firm and reliable, as in 25:5. To walk in it is to live by it and rely on it.

decisions.choice: I have walked about: I have lived
decisions.reason: The verb form (hithallekh) means to walk to and fro, to go about one's life.

decisions.choice: I live each day trusting that you keep your word
alternatives: I have walked in your faithfulness
decisions.reason: Readable says what the idiom means (m2, m3).

decisions.choice: "amour loyal" (Literal), "amour fidèle" (Balanced, Readable) for ḥesed, for the whole block
decisions.reason: Ḥesed is love that keeps faith with a promise. The Psalms terms note sets these two forms so that every chunk of Psalms reads alike; "bonté" is kept for the places where the English says "kindness".

decisions.choice: "upendo usiokoma" (love that does not stop) for loyal love at every level, through these psalms
decisions.reason: "Fadhili" is kindness or a favour done; the Hebrew word is love that keeps faith with a covenant and does not give up. "Upendo usiokoma" says that, and the same words stand at every level so readers can follow the word through the Psalms. "Fadhili" is kept for places where the English has "kindness".

decisions.choice: the deity_pronoun setting only on free pronouns and possessives ("wako|Wako", "lako|Lako")
alternatives: a capital on every pronoun for God
decisions.reason: Swahili marks most pronouns inside the verb ("unatimiza", "nimekutumaini"), and a prefix cannot take a capital, so these psalms have fewer setting spans than the English.

decisions.choice: amor leal (L); amor fiel (B, R)
decisions.reason: God's ḥesed is love that keeps faith with his people. Literal says "amor leal" and Balanced and Readable "amor fiel", as in the English, and the same words are used throughout these psalms.

decisions.choice: "tình yêu thương thành tín" (L, B); "tình thương không hề thay đổi" (R)
decisions.reason: As in the published Psalm 23:6: the word is love that keeps faith (see the meaning decision); "thành tín" carries the loyalty, and Readable says it in everyday words.

decisions.choice: "한결같은 사랑" (L, B), "변함없는 사랑" (R) for hesed; "신실하심" for emet (faithfulness)
decisions.reason: As the published Psalm 23:6 and the Psalms terms note: the word is love that keeps faith (meaning decision m1). "인자하심" is the older church word and unclear to many readers; "자비" says mercy only. The same terms hold through this block.

source.text: לֹא־יָ֭שַׁבְתִּי עִם־מְתֵי־שָׁ֑וְא וְעִ֥ם נַ֝עֲלָמִ֗ים לֹ֣א אָבֽוֹא׃

records.literal_gloss: I have not sat with men of falsehood, and with hidden ones I will not go.

en.L: I have not sat with {{gender:people|men}} of falsehood, and with those who hide [what they are] I will not go.
en.B: I have not sat among the false, and I will not keep company with those who hide what they are.
en.R: I do not spend time with liars. I do not go around with people who pretend to be good.

fr.L: Je ne me suis pas assis avec {{gender:des gens|des hommes}} de fausseté, et avec ceux qui cachent [ce qu’ils sont] je n’irai pas.
fr.B: Je ne me suis pas assis parmi les menteurs, et je ne fréquenterai pas ceux qui cachent ce qu’ils sont.
fr.R: Je ne passe pas mon temps avec les menteurs. Je ne fréquente pas les gens qui font semblant d’être bons.

sw.L: Sijaketi pamoja na watu wa uongo, wala sitakwenda pamoja na wanaoficha [walivyo].
sw.B: Sijaketi kati ya watu wadanganyifu, wala sitashirikiana na wale wanaoficha jinsi walivyo.
sw.R: Sikai pamoja na waongo. Sitembei na watu wanaojifanya kuwa wema.

es.L: No me he sentado con {{gender:gente|hombres}} de falsedad, y con los que esconden [lo que son] no andaré.
es.B: No me he sentado entre los falsos, y no andaré en compañía de los que ocultan lo que son.
es.R: No paso el tiempo con mentirosos. No ando con gente que finge ser buena.

vi.L: Tôi đã không ngồi với những kẻ giả dối, và với những kẻ che giấu [con người thật của mình] tôi sẽ không đi cùng.
vi.B: Tôi không ngồi chung với những kẻ dối trá, và tôi sẽ không kết bạn với những kẻ che giấu con người thật của mình.
vi.R: Tôi không la cà với những kẻ nói dối. Tôi không đi chung với những người giả vờ tốt lành.

ko.L: 저는 거짓된 사람들과 함께 앉지 않았고, [속을] 감추는 자들과 함께 다니지 않을 것입니다.
ko.B: 저는 거짓된 자들 사이에 앉지 않았고, 속을 감추는 자들과 어울리지 않을 것입니다.
ko.R: 저는 거짓말하는 사람들과 시간을 보내지 않습니다. 착한 척하는 사람들과 어울려 다니지 않습니다.

pt.L: Não me sentei com {{gender:pessoas|homens}} de falsidade, e com os que escondem [o que são] não andarei.
pt.B: Não me sentei entre os falsos, e não vou andar na companhia dos que escondem o que são.
pt.R: Não passo o meu tempo com mentirosos. Não ando com gente que finge ser boa.

am.L: ከሐሰት ሰዎች ጋር አልተቀመጥኩም፤ [ማንነታቸውን] ከሚሰውሩም ጋር አልሄድም።
am.B: ከሐሰተኞች ጋር አልተቀመጥኩም፤ ማንነታቸውን ከሚደብቁም ጋር አልተባበርም።
am.R: ከውሸታሞች ጋር ጊዜዬን አላሳልፍም። ጥሩ መስለው ከሚታዩ ሰዎች ጋር አልዞርም።

hi.L: मैं झूठ के लोगों के साथ नहीं बैठा, \q और छिपे रहनेवालों के साथ मैं नहीं जाऊँगा।
hi.B: मैं झूठे लोगों के बीच नहीं बैठा, और जो अपना असली रूप छिपाते हैं, \q उनकी संगति मैं नहीं करूँगा।
hi.R: मैं झूठ बोलनेवालों के साथ समय नहीं बिताता। \q मैं उन लोगों के साथ नहीं घूमता जो अच्छे होने का दिखावा करते हैं।

ru.L: Я не сидел с людьми лжи, и с теми, \q кто скрывает [себя], не пойду.
ru.B: Я не сидел среди лживых и не буду водиться с теми, \q кто скрывает своё лицо.
ru.R: Я не провожу время с лжецами. Я не вожусь с людьми, \q которые только притворяются хорошими.

ja.L: わたしは偽りの者たちとともに座ったことがなく、 \q [正体を]隠す者たちとともに行くこともない。
ja.B: わたしは偽る者たちの中に座らず、 \q 正体を隠す者たちと付き合うこともしない。
ja.R: わたしは、うそつきたちとは一緒に過ごさない。 \q よい人のふりをする人たちとも、付き合わない。

uk.L: Я не сидів з {{gender:людьми|мужами}} неправди, і з тими, \q хто приховує [себе], не піду.
uk.B: Я не сидів серед облудних і не водитимуся з тими, \q хто приховує, які вони є.
uk.R: Я не проводжу часу з брехунами. \q Я не ходжу з людьми, які вдають із себе добрих.

decisions.choice: men of falsehood: people of empty, lying words
decisions.reason: The word (shav') is emptiness and falsehood (12:3).

decisions.choice: those who hide: people who conceal what they are
decisions.reason: The verb ('alam) means to hide; these are people who hide their true aims.

decisions.choice: I have not sat: the way of Psalm 1
decisions.reason: Like the person of 1:1, the psalmist does not sit with the wicked (verse 5).

decisions.choice: people, with "men" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The phrase describes a kind of person (m1).

decisions.choice: no gender span: "những kẻ" already covers men and women
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "kẻ" and "người" name people of either sex, so there is no second wording for the gender setting to choose.

decisions.choice: "사람들" (people) with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English Literal offers "men" as an alternative. Korean "사람" is the ordinary word for a person of either sex and is what Korean says for this Hebrew, so there is no second wording to offer (style guide section 7). The same holds wherever the English has a gender span in this block.

decisions.choice: "ሰዎች" (people) with no gender span, here and in verse 9
alternatives: a gender span, as the English Literal
decisions.reason: "ሰዎች" already includes women and men, so Amharic has one wording (docs/amharic-style.md 7b).

decisions.choice: लोग, no gender span
decisions.reason: The English Literal offers "people" with "men" as the alternative. Hindi लोग already means people of any kind, so the Hindi has no span, here and in verse 9.

decisions.choice: "людьми лжи", no gender span
decisions.reason: "Люди" is the plain word for people, men or women, and needs no span in Russian, as in the New Testament in this translation.

decisions.choice: metei-shav' "偽りの者たち" (L), "偽る者たち" (B), "うそつきたち" (R), with no gender span; na'alamim "[正体を]隠す者たち" (L), "正体を隠す者たち" (B), "よい人のふりをする人たち" (R)
decisions.reason: People of empty, lying words (m1) and those who conceal what they are (m2); 者たち includes men and women, so the English span on "people" is not needed.

source.text: שָׂ֭נֵאתִי קְהַ֣ל מְרֵעִ֑ים וְעִם־רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים לֹ֣א אֵשֵֽׁב׃

records.literal_gloss: I have hated [the] assembly of evildoers, and with wicked [people] I will not sit.

en.L: I have hated the assembly of evildoers, and with [the] wicked I will not sit.
en.B: I hate the crowd that gathers to do evil; I will not take a seat among the wicked.
en.R: I hate it when people get together to do evil. I will not sit down with wicked people.

fr.L: J’ai haï l’assemblée des malfaiteurs, et avec [les] méchants je ne m’assiérai pas.
fr.B: Je hais la bande qui se réunit pour faire le mal ; je ne prendrai pas place parmi les méchants.
fr.R: Je déteste voir des gens se réunir pour faire le mal. Je ne m’assiérai pas avec les méchants.

sw.L: Nimelichukia kusanyiko la watenda maovu, wala sitaketi pamoja na waovu.
sw.B: Ninachukia kundi linalokusanyika kutenda maovu; sitaketi kati ya waovu.
sw.R: Ninachukia watu wanapokusanyika ili kutenda maovu. Sitaketi pamoja na watu waovu.

es.L: He aborrecido la asamblea de los malhechores, y con [los] malvados no me sentaré.
es.B: Odio la reunión de los que se juntan para hacer el mal; no tomaré asiento entre los malvados.
es.R: Odio que la gente se junte para hacer el mal. No me sentaré con gente malvada.

vi.L: Tôi đã ghét hội của những kẻ làm ác, và với kẻ ác tôi sẽ không ngồi.
vi.B: Tôi ghét bọn người tụ tập để làm điều ác; tôi sẽ không ngồi chung với kẻ ác.
vi.R: Tôi ghét khi người ta tụ họp lại để làm điều ác. Tôi sẽ không ngồi chung với kẻ ác.

ko.L: 저는 악을 행하는 자들의 모임을 미워하였고, 악인들과 함께 앉지 않을 것입니다.
ko.B: 저는 악을 꾀하려고 모이는 무리를 미워하며, 악인들 사이에 자리 잡고 앉지 않을 것입니다.
ko.R: 저는 사람들이 모여서 악한 일을 하는 것을 싫어합니다. 저는 악한 사람들과 함께 앉지 않겠습니다.

pt.L: Odiei a assembleia dos malfeitores, e com [os] ímpios não me sentarei.
pt.B: Odeio o bando que se reúne para fazer o mal; não vou me sentar entre os ímpios.
pt.R: Odeio quando as pessoas se juntam para fazer o mal. Não vou me sentar com gente má.

am.L: የክፉ አድራጊዎችን ጉባኤ ጠላሁ፤ ከክፉዎችም ጋር አልቀመጥም።
am.B: ክፉ ለማድረግ የሚሰበሰበውን ሕዝብ እጠላለሁ፤ ከክፉዎችም መካከል አልቀመጥም።
am.R: ሰዎች ክፉ ለማድረግ ሲሰበሰቡ እጠላለሁ። ከክፉ ሰዎች ጋር አልቀመጥም።

hi.L: मैंने कुकर्मियों की मंडली से घृणा की है, \q और दुष्टों के साथ मैं नहीं बैठूँगा।
hi.B: बुराई करने के लिए जो टोली जुटती है, उससे मैं घृणा करता हूँ; \q मैं दुष्टों के बीच आसन नहीं लूँगा।
hi.R: जब लोग बुरा काम करने के लिए इकट्ठे होते हैं, \q तो मुझे उससे घृणा है। मैं दुष्ट लोगों के साथ नहीं बैठूँगा।

ru.L: Я возненавидел сборище злодеев, \q и с нечестивыми не сяду.
ru.B: Я ненавижу толпу, что собирается творить зло; \q я не займу места среди нечестивых.
ru.R: Я ненавижу, когда люди собираются, чтобы делать зло. \q Я не сяду рядом со злыми людьми.

ja.L: わたしは悪をなす者たちの集まりを憎み、 \q 悪しき者たちとともに座らない。
ja.B: わたしは、悪事のために集まる者たちを憎む。 \q 悪しき者たちの中に、わたしは座らない。
ja.R: 人々が悪いことをするために集まるのを、わたしは憎む。 \q 悪い人たちと一緒に座ることもしない。

uk.L: Я зненавидів зібрання лиходіїв, \q і з нечестивими я не сяду.
uk.B: Я ненавиджу збіговисько, що збирається чинити зло; \q я не сяду серед нечестивих.
uk.R: Я ненавиджу, коли люди збираються, \q щоб чинити зло. Я не сяду зі злими людьми.

decisions.choice: assembly: a gathering, company
decisions.reason: The word (qahal) is often used for the gathered people of God; here it is a company of evildoers. It is set against the assemblies where the psalmist will bless the LORD (verse 12).

decisions.choice: I have hated: a settled attitude
decisions.reason: The past form describes a lasting stance: "I hate".

decisions.choice: los malvados
decisions.reason: The wicked (reshaʿim) are "los malvados" at every level, as in Proverbs, so the same people have the same name throughout these books.

decisions.choice: qehal mere'im "悪をなす者たちの集まり" (L), "悪事のために集まる者たち" (B), "悪いことをするために集まる" (R)
decisions.reason: Qahal is a gathering (m1); mere'im 悪をなす者たち keeps the participle apart from po'alei 'awen (悪を行う者たち) and ra'im (悪い者たち).

source.text: אֶרְחַ֣ץ בְּנִקָּי֣וֹן כַּפָּ֑י וַאֲסֹבְבָ֖ה אֶת־מִזְבַּחֲךָ֣ יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: I wash in innocence my palms, and I go around your altar, YHWH,

en.L: I wash my hands in innocence, and I go around {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} altar, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}},
en.B: I wash my hands to show that I am innocent, and I walk around {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} altar, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}},
en.R: I wash my hands to show that I have done nothing wrong. Then I walk around {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} altar, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: Je lave mes mains dans l’innocence, et je fais le tour de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} autel, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}},
fr.B: Je lave mes mains pour montrer que je suis innocent, et je fais le tour de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} autel, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}},
fr.R: Je lave mes mains pour montrer que je n’ai rien fait de mal. Puis je fais le tour de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} autel, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Ninanawa mikono yangu katika kutokuwa na hatia, nami ninaizunguka madhabahu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}},
sw.B: Ninanawa mikono yangu kuonyesha kwamba sina hatia, nami ninaizunguka madhabahu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}},
sw.R: Ninanawa mikono yangu kuonyesha kwamba sijafanya kosa lolote. Kisha ninaizunguka madhabahu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

es.L: Lavo en inocencia mis manos, y ando alrededor de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} altar, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}},
es.B: Lavo mis manos para mostrar que soy inocente, y camino alrededor de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} altar, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}},
es.R: Me lavo las manos para mostrar que no he hecho nada malo. Luego camino alrededor de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} altar, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

vi.L: Tôi rửa tay mình trong sự vô tội, và tôi đi quanh bàn thờ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}},
vi.B: Tôi rửa tay để tỏ ra mình vô tội, và tôi đi quanh bàn thờ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}},
vi.R: Tôi rửa tay để cho thấy tôi không làm điều gì sai. Rồi tôi đi quanh bàn thờ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 제가 무죄함 속에서 제 손바닥을 씻고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 제단을 두루 돌며,
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저는 죄 없음을 보이려고 손을 씻고, 주님의 제단을 돌며,
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저는 아무 잘못도 하지 않았음을 보이려고 손을 씻습니다. 그리고 주님의 제단을 돌며 걷습니다.

pt.L: Lavo em inocência as palmas das minhas mãos, e rodeio o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} altar, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}},
pt.B: Lavo as mãos para mostrar que sou inocente, e caminho ao redor do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} altar, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}},
pt.R: Lavo as mãos para mostrar que não fiz nada de errado. Depois caminho em volta do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} altar, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}.

am.L: እጆቼን በንጽሕና እታጠባለሁ፤ መሠዊያህንም እዞራለሁ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣
am.B: ንጹሕ መሆኔን ለማሳየት እጆቼን እታጠባለሁ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ መሠዊያህንም እዞራለሁ፤
am.R: ምንም ክፉ ነገር እንዳላደረግሁ ለማሳየት እጆቼን እታጠባለሁ። ከዚያም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ መሠዊያህን እዞራለሁ።

hi.L: मैं निर्दोषता में अपनी हथेलियाँ धोता हूँ, \q और हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तेरी वेदी के चारों ओर फिरता हूँ,
hi.B: यह दिखाने के लिए कि मैं निर्दोष हूँ, \q मैं अपने हाथ धोता हूँ, और हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तेरी वेदी की परिक्रमा करता हूँ,
hi.R: यह दिखाने के लिए कि मैंने कोई ग़लत काम नहीं किया, मैं अपने हाथ धोता हूँ। \q फिर, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मैं तेरी वेदी के चारों ओर चलता हूँ।

ru.L: Омываю в невинности руки мои \q и обхожу {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} жертвенник, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}},
ru.B: Я мою руки в знак того, что невиновен, \q и обхожу {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} жертвенник, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}},
ru.R: Я мою руки, чтобы показать, что не сделал ничего плохого. \q Потом я обхожу вокруг {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} жертвенника, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: わたしは潔白のうちに手を洗い、 \q あなたの祭壇を巡る、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしは、 \q 自分に罪がないことを示すために手を洗い、あなたの祭壇の周りを歩く、
ja.R: わたしは、何も悪いことをしていないことを示すために、手を洗う。 \q そして、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたの祭壇の周りを歩く。

uk.L: Я мию в невинності мої руки \q й обходжу {{deity_pronoun:твій|Твій}} жертовник, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}},
uk.B: Я мию руки на знак своєї невинності \q й обходжу {{deity_pronoun:твій|Твій}} жертовник, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}},
uk.R: Я мию руки, щоб показати, що не вчинив нічого поганого. \q Тоді я обходжу {{deity_pronoun:твій|Твій}} жертовник, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}.

decisions.choice: I wash my hands: a sign of innocence
decisions.reason: Washing the hands was a public sign of being clear of guilt (Deuteronomy 21:6-7); priests also washed before coming to the altar (Exodus 30:19-21).

decisions.choice: go around your altar: worship at the sanctuary
decisions.reason: Going around the altar seems to be part of worship, perhaps a procession with songs of thanks (verse 7).

decisions.choice: a sentence that runs on
decisions.reason: The sentence continues into verse 7, so this verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: to show that I am innocent
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the washing means (m1).

decisions.choice: the purpose clause of verse 7 follows the main verb of verse 6
alternatives: the purpose clause first, as Amharic usually orders it
decisions.reason: The sentence runs on into verse 7 (meaning decision m3); putting "to make heard ..." after "I go around your altar" keeps each verse's words after its own number.

decisions.choice: The sentence runs on into verse 7 with a comma at Literal and Balanced, and verse 7 gives the purpose (〜ために) after its own marker
decisions.reason: Japanese would put the purpose before the verb; keeping each verse's content in its own record, verse 7 follows as an added clause, as the English (m3).

records.literal_gloss: to make heard [the] sound of thanksgiving and to recount all your wonders.

en.L: to make heard [the] voice of thanksgiving and to recount all {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} wonders.
en.B: making a song of thanks be heard and telling of every wonder {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done.
en.R: I sing out my thanks to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. I tell about all the amazing things {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done.

fr.L: pour faire entendre [la] voix de l’action de grâce et pour raconter toutes {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} merveilles.
fr.B: en faisant retentir un chant de reconnaissance et en racontant chacune des merveilles que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as faites.
fr.R: Je chante pour {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dire merci. Je raconte toutes les choses extraordinaires que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as faites.

sw.L: ili kusikizisha sauti ya shukrani na kusimulia maajabu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yote.
sw.B: nikiufanya wimbo wa shukrani usikike na kusimulia kila ajabu uliyofanya.
sw.R: Ninakuimbia kwa sauti nikikushukuru. Ninasimulia mambo yote ya ajabu uliyoyafanya.

es.L: para hacer oír [la] voz de acción de gracias y para contar todas {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} maravillas.
es.B: haciendo que se oiga un canto de gratitud y contando cada maravilla que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho.
es.R: Canto en voz alta para darte gracias. Cuento todas las cosas asombrosas que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho.

vi.L: để làm vang lên tiếng cảm tạ và để thuật lại mọi việc diệu kỳ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: cất tiếng hát cảm tạ cho mọi người nghe và kể ra mọi việc diệu kỳ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm.
vi.R: Tôi cất tiếng hát cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Tôi kể lại mọi việc kỳ diệu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm.

ko.L: 감사의 소리를 들리게 하고 주님의 모든 기이한 일들을 이야기합니다.
ko.B: 감사의 노래를 소리 높여 부르고, 주님께서 하신 놀라운 일들을 하나하나 전합니다.
ko.R: 저는 주님께 감사의 노래를 부릅니다. 주님께서 하신 놀라운 일들을 모두 이야기합니다.

pt.L: para fazer ouvir [a] voz de ação de graças e para contar todas as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} maravilhas.
pt.B: fazendo ouvir um cântico de gratidão e contando cada maravilha que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste.
pt.R: Eu canto bem alto o meu agradecimento a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. Conto todas as coisas maravilhosas que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste.

am.L: የምስጋናን ድምፅ ለማሰማት፣ ተአምራትህንም ሁሉ ለመናገር።
am.B: የምስጋና መዝሙር እያሰማሁ፣ ያደረግኸውንም ድንቅ ሥራ ሁሉ እየተናገርኩ።
am.R: ምስጋናዬን በመዝሙር ለአንተ አሰማለሁ። ያደረግሃቸውን አስደናቂ ነገሮች ሁሉ እናገራለሁ።

hi.L: कि धन्यवाद का स्वर सुनाऊँ \q और तेरे सब आश्चर्यकर्मों का वर्णन करूँ।
hi.B: ताकि धन्यवाद का गीत सुनाई दे, \q और तेरे किए हुए हर अद्भुत काम की चर्चा हो।
hi.R: मैं ऊँचे स्वर से तेरा धन्यवाद गाता हूँ। \q मैं उन सब अद्भुत कामों के बारे में बताता हूँ जो तूने किए हैं।

ru.L: чтобы дать услышать голос благодарения \q и пересказать все {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} чудеса.
ru.B: чтобы звучала песнь благодарности \q и чтобы рассказать о каждом чуде, которое {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} совершил.
ru.R: Я громко пою {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} благодарность. \q Я рассказываю обо всех удивительных делах, которые {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} совершил.

ja.L: 感謝の声を響かせ、 \q あなたのすべての奇しいみわざを語り告げるために。
ja.B: 感謝の歌を響かせ、あなたの行われた不思議なみわざを、 \q ことごとく語り告げるために。
ja.R: わたしは、あなたに感謝の歌を歌う。 \q あなたがしてくださった驚くべきことを、すべて語り伝える。

uk.L: щоб дати почути голос подяки \q й розповісти про всі {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} чудеса.
uk.B: щоб пролунала пісня подяки \q і щоб розповісти про кожне диво, яке {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} вчинив.
uk.R: Я співаю {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}} свою подяку. \q Я розповідаю про всі дивовижні речі, які {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} зробив.

decisions.choice: thanksgiving: praise for what God has done
decisions.reason: The word (todah) is thanks spoken or sung in public, and also the offering of thanks (Leviticus 7:12).

decisions.choice: your wonders
decisions.reason: As in 9:2: God's marvelous deeds.

decisions.choice: to you
decisions.reason: Readable makes a new sentence and says to whom the thanks is sung.

decisions.choice: nifle'ot "奇しいみわざ" (L), "不思議なみわざ" (B), "驚くべきこと" (R), as 1 Chronicles 16:9, 12, 24; for the Psalter
decisions.reason: God's wonders (m2) take the words the song of 1 Chronicles 16 (= Psalms 96, 105) already uses.

source.text: יְֽהוָ֗ה אָ֭הַבְתִּי מְע֣וֹן בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מְק֗וֹם מִשְׁכַּ֥ן כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH, I love [the] habitation of your house and [the] place of [the] dwelling of your glory.

en.L: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, I love the habitation of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} house and the place of the dwelling of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} glory.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, I love the house that is {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} home, the place in which {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} glory has its dwelling.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, I love {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} house, where {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} live. Your shining glory is there.

fr.L: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, j’aime la demeure de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} maison et le lieu de la résidence de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} gloire.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, j’aime la maison où {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} habites, le lieu où {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} gloire a sa demeure.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, j’aime {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} maison, où {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} vis. Ta gloire brillante est là.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninapenda makao ya nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} na mahali pa maskani ya utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninaipenda nyumba iliyo makao {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, mahali ambapo utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} unakaa.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninaipenda nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, mahali unapoishi. Utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} unaong'aa uko pale.

es.L: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, amo la morada de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} casa y el lugar de la habitación de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} gloria.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, amo la casa que es {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} hogar, el lugar donde {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} gloria tiene su morada.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, amo {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} casa, donde {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} vives. Allí está {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} gloria resplandeciente.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tôi yêu mến nơi ở của nhà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và nơi ngự của vinh quang {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tôi yêu mến ngôi nhà là nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở, nơi vinh quang của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngự.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tôi yêu mến nhà của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở. Vinh quang rực rỡ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở đó.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저는 주님의 집의 거처와 주님의 영광이 거하는 처소를 사랑합니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저는 주님께서 계시는 집, 주님의 영광이 머무는 곳을 사랑합니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저는 주님께서 계시는 주님의 집을 사랑합니다. 그곳에 주님의 빛나는 영광이 있습니다.

pt.L: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, amo o abrigo da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} casa e o lugar onde mora a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} glória.
pt.B: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, eu amo a casa que é o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} lar, o lugar onde a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} glória faz morada.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, eu amo a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} casa, onde {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} moras. A {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} glória brilhante está ali.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ የቤትህን መኖሪያ፣ የክብርህንም ማደሪያ ስፍራ እወዳለሁ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ መኖሪያህ የሆነውን ቤት፣ ክብርህ የሚያድርበትን ስፍራ እወዳለሁ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ የምትኖርበትን ቤትህን እወዳለሁ። የሚያበራው ክብርህ በዚያ አለ።

hi.L: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मैं तेरे भवन के निवास से और तेरी महिमा के वास के स्थान से प्रेम करता हूँ।
hi.B: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मुझे वह भवन प्रिय है जो तेरा घर है, \q वह स्थान जहाँ तेरी महिमा वास करती है।
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मुझे तेरा भवन प्रिय है, जहाँ तू रहता है। \q तेरी चमकती महिमा वहाँ है।

ru.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, я люблю обитель {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} дома \q и место пребывания {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} славы.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, я люблю дом, где {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} живёшь, место, \q в котором обитает {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} слава.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, я люблю {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} дом, где {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} живёшь. \q Там сияет {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} слава.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしはあなたの家の住まいと、 \q あなたの栄光の宿る所を愛する。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしは、あなたの住まいである家、 \q あなたの栄光が宿る所を愛する。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしは、あなたが住んでおられる、あなたの家を愛している。 \q そこには、あなたの輝く栄光がある。

uk.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, я люблю оселю {{deity_pronoun:твого|Твого}} дому \q і місце перебування {{deity_pronoun:твоєї|Твоєї}} слави.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, я люблю дім, що є {{deity_pronoun:твоєю|Твоєю}} оселею, \q місце, де перебуває {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} слава.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, я люблю {{deity_pronoun:твій|Твій}} дім, де {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} живеш. \q Там сяє {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} слава.

decisions.choice: your glory: your presence made visible
decisions.reason: God's glory (kavod) is his presence shown to people, as when it filled the tabernacle (Exodus 40:34).

decisions.choice: dwelling: the place where God lives among his people
decisions.reason: The word (mishkan) is the word used for the tabernacle, God's dwelling.

decisions.choice: shining glory
decisions.reason: Readable adds "shining" to help a reader picture what glory is (m1).

decisions.choice: "дом, где ты живёшь"
decisions.reason: Russian says that the house is God's home with a clause about his living there; the sense of the English "the house that is your home" is the same.

decisions.choice: "{{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} слава" with a span
alternatives: no span, as the English sentence-initial "Your"
decisions.reason: Russian puts the verb first, so the pronoun stands mid-sentence and takes the span.

source.text: אַל־תֶּאֱסֹ֣ף עִם־חַטָּאִ֣ים נַפְשִׁ֑י וְעִם־אַנְשֵׁ֖י דָמִ֣ים חַיָּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Do not gather with sinners my soul, and with men of bloods my life,

en.L: Do not gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with {{gender:people|men}} of bloodshed,
en.B: Do not carry me off with the sinners, or my life with those who shed blood,
en.R: When {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} take sinners away, do not take me with them. Do not let me die with murderers.

fr.L: N’enlève pas mon âme avec les pécheurs, ni ma vie avec {{gender:les gens|les hommes}} de sang,
fr.B: Ne m’emporte pas avec les pécheurs, ni ma vie avec ceux qui versent le sang,
fr.R: Quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} emportes les pécheurs, ne m’emporte pas avec eux. Ne me laisse pas mourir avec les assassins.

sw.L: Usiikusanye nafsi yangu pamoja na wenye dhambi, wala uhai wangu pamoja na watu wa damu,
sw.B: Usinichukue pamoja na wenye dhambi, wala uhai wangu pamoja na wale wanaomwaga damu,
sw.R: Unapowaondoa wenye dhambi, usinichukue pamoja nao. Usiniache nife pamoja na wauaji.

es.L: No recojas mi alma con los pecadores, ni mi vida con {{gender:gente|hombres}} de sangre,
es.B: No me lleves junto con los pecadores, ni mi vida con los que derraman sangre,
es.R: Cuando {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} te lleves a los pecadores, no me lleves con ellos. No dejes que muera con los asesinos.

vi.L: Xin đừng cất linh hồn tôi đi cùng với những kẻ tội lỗi, cũng đừng cất mạng sống tôi đi cùng với những kẻ làm đổ máu,
vi.B: Xin đừng mang tôi đi chung với những kẻ tội lỗi, hay cất mạng sống tôi đi chung với những kẻ làm đổ máu,
vi.R: Khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cất bỏ những kẻ tội lỗi, xin đừng mang tôi đi với chúng. Xin đừng để tôi chết chung với những kẻ giết người.

ko.L: 제 영혼을 죄인들과 함께 거두지 마시고, 제 생명을 피 흘린 사람들과 함께 [거두지] 마십시오.
ko.B: 저를 죄인들과 함께 쓸어 가지 마시고, 제 목숨을 피 흘리는 자들과 함께 앗아 가지 마십시오.
ko.R: 주님께서 죄인들을 데려가실 때 저까지 데려가지 마십시오. 살인자들과 함께 제가 죽지 않게 해 주십시오.

pt.L: Não juntes a minha alma com [os] pecadores, nem a minha vida com {{gender:pessoas|homens}} de sangue,
pt.B: Não me leves junto com os pecadores, nem a minha vida com os que derramam sangue,
pt.R: Quando {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} levares embora os pecadores, não me leves com eles. Não deixes que eu morra junto com assassinos.

am.L: ነፍሴን ከኃጢአተኞች ጋር፣ ሕይወቴንም ከደም ሰዎች ጋር አትሰብስብ፤
am.B: ከኃጢአተኞች ጋር አትውሰደኝ፤ ሕይወቴንም ደም ከሚያፈሱ ጋር አትውሰዳት፤
am.R: ኃጢአተኞችን በምትወስድበት ጊዜ ከእነርሱ ጋር አትውሰደኝ። ከነፍሰ ገዳዮችም ጋር እንድሞት አታድርግ።

hi.L: पापियों के साथ मेरे प्राण को, \q और ख़ून के दोषी लोगों के साथ मेरे जीवन को न समेट ले,
hi.B: पापियों के साथ मुझे न उठा ले, \q न ख़ून बहानेवालों के साथ मेरे प्राण ले,
hi.R: जब तू पापियों को उठा ले जाए, तो मुझे उनके साथ न ले जाना। \q मुझे हत्यारों के साथ मरने न देना।

ru.L: Не забирай с грешниками душу мою \q и с людьми кровопролития — жизнь мою,
ru.B: Не уноси меня вместе с грешниками и мою жизнь — \q с теми, кто проливает кровь,
ru.R: Когда {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} будешь забирать грешников, не забирай меня вместе с ними. \q Не дай мне умереть вместе с убийцами.

ja.L: 罪人たちとともにわたしの魂を、血の者たちとともにわたしの命を、 \q 取り去らないでください、
ja.B: わたしを罪人たちとともに、わたしの命を血を流す者たちとともに、 \q 連れ去らないでください、
ja.R: あなたが罪人たちを取り去るときに、わたしを一緒に取り去らないでください。 \q 人を殺す人たちと一緒に、わたしを死なせないでください。

uk.L: Не забирай моєї душі з грішниками, \q ані мого життя з {{gender:людьми|мужами}} кровопролиття,
uk.B: Не забирай мене разом із грішниками, \q ані мого життя з тими, хто проливає кров,
uk.R: Коли {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} забиратимеш грішників, не забирай мене з ними. \q Не дай мені загинути разом з убивцями.

decisions.choice: gather: take away in death
decisions.reason: To be gathered is to be taken away at death (Genesis 25:8). The psalmist asks not to share the end of the wicked.

decisions.choice: men of bloods: people guilty of bloodshed
decisions.reason: The plural "bloods" means blood that has been shed; these are killers (5:7).

decisions.choice: a sentence that runs on
decisions.reason: The sentence continues into verse 10, so this verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: people, with "men" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The phrase describes a kind of person (m2).

decisions.choice: When you take sinners away ... do not let me die
alternatives: Do not gather my soul with sinners
decisions.reason: Readable says what the idiom means (m1).

decisions.choice: mi alma
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew nefesh as "alma", as the terms for these books settle; Balanced and Readable say "me", the person himself, as the English does.

decisions.choice: te'esof "取り去らないでください" (L), "連れ去らないでください" (B), "取り去らないでください" / "死なせないでください" (R); 'anshei damim "血の者たち" (L), "血を流す者たち" (B), "人を殺す人たち" (R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: To gather is to take away in death (m1), and men of bloods are people guilty of bloodshed (m2). Both objects come before the one verb in Japanese, and the sentence runs on with a comma into verse 10 at Literal and Balanced (m3).

records.literal_gloss: who in their hands [is] wickedness, and their right hand is full of bribe.

en.L: in whose hands [is] a wicked scheme, and their right hand is full of bribery.
en.B: people whose hands carry out shameful plots and whose right hand is loaded with bribes.
en.R: They are always planning evil, and they take money to do wrong.

fr.L: dans les mains desquels [il y a] un projet infâme, et leur droite est pleine de pots-de-vin.
fr.B: des gens dont les mains exécutent des complots honteux et dont la main droite est chargée de pots-de-vin.
fr.R: Ils préparent toujours le mal, et ils acceptent de l’argent pour faire ce qui est injuste.

sw.L: ambao mikononi mwao [mna] hila mbaya, na mkono wao wa kuume umejaa rushwa.
sw.B: watu ambao mikono yao hutekeleza mipango ya aibu, na mkono wao wa kuume umejaa rushwa.
sw.R: Wao hupanga maovu siku zote, na hupokea pesa ili kutenda mabaya.

es.L: en cuyas manos [hay] maquinación perversa, y su mano derecha está llena de soborno.
es.B: gente cuyas manos llevan a cabo planes vergonzosos y cuya mano derecha está cargada de sobornos.
es.R: Siempre están planeando el mal, y aceptan dinero para hacer lo malo.

vi.L: là những kẻ trong tay [có] mưu ác, và tay phải của chúng đầy của hối lộ.
vi.B: là những kẻ có bàn tay thực hiện mưu đồ xấu xa và tay phải đầy của hối lộ.
vi.R: Chúng luôn tính chuyện ác, và chúng nhận tiền để làm điều sai.

ko.L: 그들의 손에는 악한 계략이 [있고], 그들의 오른손에는 뇌물이 가득합니다.
ko.B: 그들은 손으로 부끄러운 음모를 꾸미고, 오른손에는 뇌물이 가득한 자들입니다.
ko.R: 그들은 늘 악한 일을 꾸미고, 돈을 받고 나쁜 일을 합니다.

pt.L: em cujas mãos [há] um plano perverso, e cuja mão direita está cheia de suborno.
pt.B: gente cujas mãos executam planos vergonhosos e cuja mão direita está carregada de subornos.
pt.R: Eles vivem planejando o mal e aceitam dinheiro para fazer o que é errado.

am.L: በእጆቻቸው ተንኰል [ያለባቸው]፣ ቀኝ እጃቸውም ጉቦ የሞላባት።
am.B: እጆቻቸው አሳፋሪ ሤራ የሚፈጽሙ፣ ቀኝ እጃቸውም በጉቦ የተሞላ ሰዎች።
am.R: ሁልጊዜ ክፉ ነገር ያቅዳሉ፤ ክፉ ለማድረግም ገንዘብ ይቀበላሉ።

hi.L: जिनके हाथों में कुचक्र [है], \q और जिनका दाहिना हाथ घूस से भरा है।
hi.B: ऐसे लोग जिनके हाथ घिनौनी चालें चलते हैं \q और जिनका दाहिना हाथ रिश्वत से लदा है।
hi.R: वे हमेशा बुराई की योजना बनाते रहते हैं, \q और ग़लत काम करने के लिए पैसे लेते हैं।

ru.L: в чьих руках — злой умысел, \q и правая рука их полна взяток.
ru.B: людьми, чьи руки творят постыдные замыслы \q и чья правая рука набита взятками.
ru.R: Они всё время замышляют зло и берут деньги, \q чтобы делать неправду.

ja.L: その者たちの手には悪だくみがあり、 \q その右の手は賄賂で満ちている。
ja.B: その手は恥ずべき企てを行い、 \q その右の手は賄賂でいっぱいだ。
ja.R: 彼らはいつも悪いことを計画し、 \q お金をもらって悪いことをする。

uk.L: у чиїх руках — лихий задум, \q і їхня правиця повна хабарів.
uk.B: з людьми, чиї руки здійснюють ганебні задуми \q і чия правиця обтяжена хабарями.
uk.R: Вони завжди задумують зло й беруть гроші, \q щоб чинити неправду.

decisions.choice: wickedness: a shameful plan
decisions.reason: The word (zimmah) is a plan or deed that is deliberately evil.

decisions.choice: bribe: a gift to twist justice
decisions.reason: A bribe (shochad) blinds the eyes of judges (Exodus 23:8; Deuteronomy 16:19).

decisions.choice: they take money to do wrong
alternatives: their right hand is full of bribery
decisions.reason: Readable says what the bribes are for (m2).

decisions.choice: The relative "who" that ties verse 10 to verse 9 becomes a new sentence about "그들" (them)
alternatives: a relative clause placed before "사람들" in verse 9
decisions.reason: Korean puts a relative clause before its noun, so keeping it would move verse 10 into verse 9; a new sentence keeps each verse with its own words.

decisions.choice: zimmah "悪だくみ" (L), "恥ずべき企て" (B), "悪いことを計画し" (R); shochad "賄賂" (L, B), "お金をもらって悪いことをする" (R)
decisions.reason: Zimmah is a shameful plan (m1) and shochad a gift to twist justice (m2); verse 10 describes the people of verse 9, so it opens with その者たち / その.

records.literal_gloss: But I in my integrity will walk; redeem me and be gracious to me.

en.L: But I, in my integrity I will walk; redeem me and be gracious to me.
en.B: But as for me, I will live with integrity; set me free and show me grace.
en.R: But I will keep living an honest life. Rescue me and be kind to me.

fr.L: Mais moi, dans mon intégrité je marcherai ; rachète-moi et fais-moi grâce.
fr.B: Quant à moi, je vivrai avec intégrité ; libère-moi et montre-moi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} grâce.
fr.R: Mais moi, je vais continuer à mener une vie honnête. Délivre-moi et sois bon pour moi.

sw.L: Lakini mimi, katika uadilifu wangu nitaenenda; unikomboe na unifanyie neema.
sw.B: Lakini mimi nitaishi kwa uadilifu; uniweke huru na unionyeshe neema.
sw.R: Lakini mimi nitaendelea kuishi kwa moyo mnyoofu. Uniokoe na unitendee wema.

es.L: Pero yo, en mi integridad andaré; redímeme y ten piedad de mí.
es.B: Pero yo viviré con integridad; líbrame y ten compasión de mí.
es.R: Pero yo seguiré viviendo una vida honrada. Rescátame y sé bueno conmigo.

vi.L: Còn tôi, trong sự trọn vẹn của tôi tôi sẽ bước đi; xin chuộc tôi và thương xót tôi.
vi.B: Còn tôi, tôi sẽ sống ngay thật trọn vẹn; xin giải thoát tôi và tỏ ân huệ cho tôi.
vi.R: Còn tôi, tôi sẽ tiếp tục sống ngay thật. Xin giải cứu tôi và thương xót tôi.

ko.L: 그러나 저는 제 온전함 가운데 걷겠습니다. 저를 속량하시고 저에게 은혜를 베풀어 주십시오.
ko.B: 그러나 저는 온전하게 살겠습니다. 저를 건져 주시고 은혜를 베풀어 주십시오.
ko.R: 그러나 저는 계속 정직하게 살겠습니다. 저를 구해 주시고 저를 불쌍히 여겨 주십시오.

pt.L: Mas eu, na minha integridade andarei; resgata-me e sê bondoso comigo.
pt.B: Quanto a mim, viverei com integridade; liberta-me e mostra-me a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} graça.
pt.R: Mas eu vou continuar levando uma vida honesta. Salva-me e sê bondoso comigo.

am.L: እኔ ግን በፍጹምነቴ እሄዳለሁ፤ ዋጀኝ፤ ራራልኝም።
am.B: እኔ ግን በፍጹምነት እኖራለሁ፤ ነጻ አውጣኝ፤ ሞገስም አሳየኝ።
am.R: እኔ ግን በታማኝነት መኖሬን እቀጥላለሁ። አድነኝ፤ ደግነትም አድርግልኝ።

hi.L: पर मैं, अपनी खराई में मैं चलूँगा; मुझे छुड़ा ले और मुझ पर अनुग्रह कर।
hi.B: पर मैं तो खराई से जीवन बिताऊँगा; मुझे छुड़ा और मुझ पर अनुग्रह कर।
hi.R: पर मैं ईमानदारी का जीवन जीता रहूँगा। मुझे बचा और मुझ पर दया कर।

ru.L: А я — в непорочности моей буду ходить; искупи меня и помилуй меня.
ru.B: А я буду жить непорочно; освободи меня и окажи мне милость.
ru.R: Но я буду и дальше жить честно. Спаси меня и будь добр ко мне.

ja.L: しかしわたしは、潔白のうちに歩む。わたしを贖い、わたしをあわれんでください。
ja.B: しかし、わたしは潔白に生きていく。わたしを救い出し、恵みを示してください。
ja.R: しかし、わたしはこれからも正直に生きていく。わたしを助け出し、あわれんでください。

uk.L: А я — у своїй непорочності ходитиму; викупи мене й змилуйся наді мною.
uk.B: А я житиму непорочно; визволи мене й змилуйся наді мною.
uk.R: Але я й далі житиму чесним життям. Урятуй мене й будь до мене добрий.

decisions.choice: But I: unlike them
decisions.reason: The pronoun is added to set the psalmist against the people of verses 9-10.

decisions.choice: redeem me: set me free
decisions.reason: As in 25:22.

source.text: רַ֭גְלִי עָֽמְדָ֣ה בְמִישׁ֑וֹר בְּ֝מַקְהֵלִ֗ים אֲבָרֵ֥ךְ יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: My foot has stood on level ground; in assemblies I will bless YHWH.

en.L: My foot has stood on level ground; in [the] assemblies I will bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: I stand firm on level ground; in the assemblies I will bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: I am standing on safe, level ground. When God's people meet together, I will praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: Mon pied s’est tenu sur un terrain plat ; dans [les] assemblées je bénirai {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Je me tiens ferme sur un terrain plat ; dans les assemblées je bénirai {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Je me tiens sur un terrain sûr et plat. Quand le peuple de Dieu se réunira, je louerai {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Mguu wangu umesimama mahali palipo sawa; katika makusanyiko nitambariki {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Ninasimama imara mahali palipo sawa; katika makusanyiko nitambariki {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Nimesimama mahali salama, palipo sawa. Watu wa Mungu wanapokutana pamoja, nitamsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

es.L: Mi pie ha estado en tierra llana; en [las] asambleas bendeciré {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: Estoy firme en terreno llano; en las asambleas bendeciré {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: Estoy de pie en un lugar llano y seguro. Cuando el pueblo de Dios se reúna, alabaré {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

vi.L: Chân tôi đã đứng trên đất bằng; trong [các] hội chúng tôi sẽ chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Tôi đứng vững trên đất bằng; trong các hội chúng tôi sẽ chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Tôi đang đứng trên đất bằng và an toàn. Khi dân của Đức Chúa Trời nhóm lại, tôi sẽ ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 제 발이 평탄한 곳에 섰습니다. 회중들 가운데서 제가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 송축하겠습니다.
ko.B: 저는 평탄한 땅에 굳게 서 있습니다. 모임들 가운데서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 송축하겠습니다.
ko.R: 저는 안전하고 평평한 땅에 서 있습니다. 하나님의 백성이 함께 모일 때 저는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양하겠습니다.

pt.L: O meu pé tem estado em chão plano; nas assembleias bendirei {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Piso firme em terreno nivelado; nas assembleias vou bendizer {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Estou pisando em chão plano e seguro. Quando o povo de Deus se reunir, vou louvar {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

am.L: እግሬ በደልዳላ ስፍራ ቆማለች፤ በጉባኤዎች {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} እባርካለሁ።
am.B: በደልዳላ መሬት ላይ ጸንቼ ቆሜአለሁ፤ በጉባኤዎች መካከል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} እባርካለሁ።
am.R: ደኅና በሆነ ደልዳላ መሬት ላይ ቆሜአለሁ። የእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ በሚሰበሰብበት ጊዜ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} አመሰግናለሁ።

hi.L: मेरा पाँव समतल भूमि पर खड़ा है; \q मंडलियों में मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को धन्य कहूँगा।
hi.B: मैं समतल भूमि पर दृढ़ खड़ा हूँ; \q मंडलियों में मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को धन्य कहूँगा।
hi.R: मैं सुरक्षित, समतल ज़मीन पर खड़ा हूँ। \q जब परमेश्वर के लोग इकट्ठे होंगे, तब मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की स्तुति करूँगा।

ru.L: Нога моя стоит на ровном месте; \q в собраниях буду благословлять {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Я твёрдо стою на ровной земле; \q в собраниях я буду благословлять {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Я стою на надёжной, ровной земле. \q Когда Божий народ соберётся вместе, я буду хвалить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.

ja.L: わたしの足は平らな所に立った。 \q 集いの中で、わたしは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をほめたたえる。
ja.B: わたしは平らな地にしっかりと立つ。 \q 集いの中で、わたしは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をほめたたえる。
ja.R: わたしは、安全で平らな地面に立っている。 \q 神の民が集まるとき、わたしは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をほめたたえる。

uk.L: Моя нога стала на рівному місці; \q у зібраннях я благословлятиму {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.
uk.B: Я стою твердо на рівній землі; \q у зібраннях я благословлятиму {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Я стою на безпечній, рівній землі. \q Коли Божий народ збирається разом, я хвалитиму {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.

decisions.choice: level ground: a safe place to stand
decisions.reason: Level ground is safe footing, with nothing to trip on; it also suggests uprightness (27:11).

decisions.choice: assemblies: the gatherings of God's people
decisions.reason: The gatherings for worship stand against the assembly of evildoers (verse 5).

decisions.choice: bless the LORD: praise him
decisions.reason: When people bless God, they praise and thank him.

decisions.choice: God's people
decisions.reason: Readable says who gathers (m2).

decisions.choice: bless the LORD "ባረከ" (L, B), "አመሰገነ" (R)
decisions.reason: As the terms list: to bless God is to praise him (meaning decision m3), which Readable says plainly.

decisions.choice: धन्य कहना
decisions.reason: To bless God is to praise him (m3); Hindi says धन्य कहना for blessing God, keeping आशीष देना for God or people blessing others. Readable says स्तुति करना, as the English "praise".

decisions.choice: maqhelim "集い" (every level; R "神の民が集まるとき"); barekh "ほめたたえる" at every level
decisions.reason: The assemblies are the gatherings of God's people for worship (m2); to bless the LORD is to praise him (m3), ほめたたえる as the Psalter's barekh.
